question: Does the current TRUMP algorithm establish a complete polynomial-time decision procedure for arbitrary CNF SAT sufficient to close P vs NP?
closure_rule: P_VS_NP may be promoted from OPEN only if every mandatory theorem obligation is established without finite-size caps, empirical extrapolation, hidden exponential fallback, oracle/advice, or post-hoc route selection.
forbidden_promotions: Finite exact success implies polynomial-time arbitrary-CNF SAT.
A replayable SAT witness supplies a polynomial UNSAT decision proof.
A structural meet implies a speedup.
A bounded discovery arena proves asymptotic complexity.
An exact DPLL or exhaustive-search fallback may be ignored in end-to-end complexity accounting.
